items.example: Let us stop arguing about ownership and design the experiment.
items.example_zh: 我們別再爭權責歸屬，先把實驗設計出來。

items.def_en: The senior person who backs a project and removes obstacles.
items.example: The sponsor for this improvement is the quality director.
items.example_zh: 這項改善的支持主管是品質總監。

items.def_en: The first meeting that starts a project and aligns everyone.
items.example: The kickoff is next Tuesday and should take one hour.
items.example_zh: 啟動會議在下週二，預計一小時。

items.def_en: The point where responsibility passes from one team to another.
items.example: Most delays happen at the handoff between test and assembly.
items.example_zh: 多數延遲發生在測試與封裝的交接點。

items.def_en: A planned moment to review progress before continuing.
items.example: We set a checkpoint after the first three lots.
items.example_zh: 我們在前三個批次之後設了一個查核點。

items.def_en: A formal review that decides whether a project can move to the next phase.
items.example: The gate review requires the full reliability data package.
items.example_zh: 階段關卡審查需要完整的可靠度資料包。

items.def_en: A meeting held after the work to capture what to do differently next time.
items.example: The retrospective produced two lessons we turned into standard procedure.
items.example_zh: 回顧檢討產出兩項教訓，我們把它們寫進標準程序。

items.def_en: The key point the audience should remember afterwards.
items.example: The main takeaway is that the alarm limit, not the tool, was the problem.
items.example_zh: 最重要的重點是：問題出在警報界限，不是機台本身。

items.def_en: A high-level plan showing what happens in which period.
items.example: The roadmap puts the process transition in the first quarter.
items.example_zh: 時程藍圖把製程移轉排在第一季。

items.def_en: The sequence of events with their dates.
items.example: Slide 2 lays out the timeline from detection to containment.
items.example_zh: 第 2 頁列出了從發現到圍堵的時間軸。

items.def_en: The chain of tasks that decides the earliest possible finish date.
items.example: The cross-section is on the critical path, so it gets priority.
items.example_zh: 剖面分析在要徑上，所以優先處理。

items.def_en: Spare time built into a plan to absorb problems.
items.example: We added one week of buffer so the new date can hold.
items.example_zh: 我們加了一週緩衝，讓新日期站得住。

items.def_en: A delay against the planned date.
items.example: The slippage is two weeks, and it comes entirely from the furnace queue.
items.example_zh: 延誤是兩週，全部來自爐管排隊。

items.def_en: Something that stops work from continuing until it is resolved.
items.example: The only blocker today is access to the customer's system log.
items.example_zh: 今天唯一的阻礙是拿不到客戶的系統日誌。

items.def_en: The action taken to reduce a risk before it becomes a problem.
items.example: Our mitigation is to book a second furnace slot in advance.
items.example_zh: 我們的緩解措施是預先多訂一個爐管時段。

items.def_en: The plan you switch to if the main plan fails.
items.example: The fallback is the screened material, which covers 60 percent of demand.
items.example_zh: 備案是已篩選的材料，可涵蓋 60% 的需求。

items.def_en: Returning to the previous version or condition after a change fails.
items.example: The rollback plan is to restore the old recipe within one shift.
items.example_zh: 回復方案是在一個班別內恢復舊配方。

items.def_en: One parallel track of work inside a larger project.
items.example: The reliability workstream can run in parallel with the process one.
items.example_zh: 可靠度這條工作分支可以和製程那條平行進行。

items.def_en: To put a change into the live environment.
items.example: We deploy the new limit to all furnaces on the same day.
items.example_zh: 我們在同一天把新界限佈署到所有爐管。

items.def_en: To plan the end of life of a product or process.
items.example: We will sunset the old recipe once three lots pass on the new one.
items.example_zh: 新配方跑過三批之後，舊配方就會退場。

items.def_en: The regular rhythm at which something happens.
items.example: We moved to a weekly cadence for all open customer cases.
items.example_zh: 所有未結客戶案件都改成每週一次的節奏。

items.def_en: How fine the level of detail is.
items.example: We need lot-level granularity, not just a monthly average.
items.example_zh: 我們需要批次層級的細緻度，不是只有月平均。

items.def_en: To combine individual numbers into a single summary value.
items.example: If we aggregate across all lots, the signal disappears.
items.example_zh: 如果把所有批次彙總起來，訊號就會不見。

items.def_en: A smaller group taken from a larger one.
items.example: Only a subset of the returned units shares the same mechanism.
items.example_zh: 退回品中只有一部分具有相同的機制。

items.def_en: An indirect measurement used when the real one is not available.
items.example: Spare block usage is a proxy for cell health in the field.
items.example_zh: 備用區塊使用量可作為現場記憶胞健康度的替代指標。

items.def_en: A factor of about ten, used when only the rough scale matters.
items.example: The two failure rates differ by an order of magnitude.
items.example_zh: 這兩個失效率差了一個數量級。

items.def_en: The least favourable outcome that still needs to be planned for.
items.example: In the worst case the release moves by two weeks.
items.example_zh: 最壞情況是放行往後兩週。

items.def_en: How probable something is.
items.example: The likelihood of a repeat is low now that the tool shuts down automatically.
items.example_zh: 機台已能自動停機，再發生的機率很低。

items.def_en: How much material or money is at risk.
items.example: Our exposure is 12 shipped lots, about 240,000 units.
items.example_zh: 我們的風險暴露是 12 個已出貨批次，約 24 萬顆。

items.def_en: The effect a problem or change has on the product, schedule or customer.
items.example: The impact on the product is none; only the site code changes.
items.example_zh: 對產品的影響為零，只有廠區代碼改變。

items.def_en: The visible effect of a problem, as opposed to its cause.
items.example: The yield drop is the symptom; the pressure drift is the cause.
items.example_zh: 良率下滑是症狀，壓力漂移才是原因。

items.def_en: Data or observations that support a conclusion.
items.example: Every statement in the report should be backed by evidence.
items.example_zh: 報告裡的每一句話都應該有證據支撐。

items.def_en: A conclusion drawn from evidence rather than observed directly.
items.example: That is an inference, not a measurement; let us label it clearly.
items.example_zh: 那是推論不是量測值，我們要標示清楚。

items.def_en: The action the report suggests should be taken.
items.example: Our recommendation is to keep the case open until the two units are analysed.
items.example_zh: 我們的建議是在那兩顆分析完成前先不結案。

items.def_en: What the analysis cannot tell you, stated honestly.
items.example: One limitation is that only two units were cross-sectioned.
items.example_zh: 一項限制是只有兩顆做了剖面分析。

items.def_en: Being the same throughout, with no contradictions.
items.example: Check the consistency between the summary and the detailed data.
items.example_zh: 請檢查摘要與詳細資料之間的一致性。

items.def_en: How much others trust what you say, based on your track record.
items.example: Missing a committed date twice costs more credibility than the failure itself.
items.example_zh: 連續兩次跳票對可信度的傷害，比失效本身還大。

items.def_en: Being answerable for a result, not just for doing the task.
items.example: Accountability for closing the case sits with the device team.
items.example_zh: 本案結案的當責單位是元件團隊。

items.def_en: Being honest about the data, including what does not look good.
items.example: Data integrity matters more than a clean-looking chart.
items.example_zh: 資料的誠信比一張好看的圖表重要得多。

items.def_en: The freedom to decide something yourself within limits.
items.example: Shipping under waiver is not at the engineer's discretion.
items.example_zh: 以特採出貨不是工程師可以自行斟酌的事。

items.def_en: The attitude a message conveys, apart from its content.
items.example: The content was right but the tone read as defensive.
items.example_zh: 內容沒錯，但語氣讀起來像在辯解。

items.def_en: The exact choice of words in a sentence.
items.example: The spec wording is ambiguous, so both sides read it differently.
items.example_zh: 規格的措辭含糊，導致雙方解讀不同。

items.def_en: A small difference in meaning that changes how a message lands.
items.example: There is a nuance between suspected and confirmed root cause.
items.example_zh: suspected 與 confirmed 的根本原因之間有細微但重要的差別。

items.def_en: A version that is not final and is expected to change.
items.example: Let me run the draft reply by my manager before we send it.
items.example_zh: 回信草稿我先給主管看過再寄出。

items.def_en: A file sent together with an email.
items.example: The correlation report is in the attachment.
items.example_zh: 相關性報告在附件中。

items.def_en: The person a message is addressed to.
items.example: Check the recipient list before you send anything about a customer case.
items.example_zh: 寄出任何客訴相關內容前，先檢查收件人清單。

items.def_en: A chain of replies on the same email topic.
items.example: Please keep the discussion in this thread so the history stays together.
items.example_zh: 請把討論留在這個郵件串裡，歷程才不會斷。

items.def_en: The one-line summary that decides whether your email gets opened.
items.example: Put the case number in the subject line so it can be searched later.
items.example_zh: 把案號放進郵件主旨，之後才搜尋得到。

items.def_en: Supporting material placed at the end of a report.
items.example: The raw data is in the appendix so the main text stays readable.
items.example_zh: 原始資料放在附錄，正文才讀得下去。

items.def_en: A standard format reused for every report of the same kind.
items.example: Use the customer's template; they reject reports in other formats.
items.example_zh: 請用客戶的範本，其他格式他們會退件。

items.def_en: Standard text reused without change in every document.
items.example: Do not let the boilerplate hide the one sentence that matters.
items.example_zh: 別讓制式套語把真正重要的那一句蓋掉。

items.def_en: A statement limiting what the document should be relied on for.
items.example: The disclaimer says preliminary data must not be used for design decisions.
items.example_zh: 免責聲明寫明初步資料不得作為設計決策依據。

items.def_en: A short form made from the first letters of several words.
items.example: Spell out the acronym the first time it appears in the report.
items.example_zh: 縮寫字第一次出現時要寫出全稱。

items.def_en: The set of technical words used consistently in a field or company.
items.example: Align the terminology with the customer's quality manual.
items.example_zh: 術語用法要與客戶的品質手冊一致。

items.def_en: A short meeting that gives people the information they need before acting.
items.example: I will give the night shift a briefing before the change goes in.
items.example_zh: 變更導入前我會先對夜班做簡短說明。

items.def_en: A short review right after an event to capture what happened.
items.example: Let us do a debrief right after the customer call while it is fresh.
items.example_zh: 客戶會議一結束就趁記憶新鮮做個檢討。

items.def_en: A full practice of a presentation before the real one.
items.example: We will do a dry run on Thursday with the same slides.
items.example_zh: 我們週四會用同一份投影片做一次試講。

items.def_en: Printed or shared material given to the audience.
items.example: The handout has the numbers, so the slides can stay simple.
items.example_zh: 數字放在講義裡，投影片就可以保持簡潔。

items.def_en: A chart, photo or diagram that helps the audience follow.
items.example: A wafer map is the strongest visual aid in this kind of review.
items.example_zh: 在這類檢討會中，晶圓分佈圖是最有力的視覺輔助。

items.def_en: The people you are speaking to, whose level sets your depth.
items.example: Know your audience: the customer director does not want the physics.
items.example_zh: 先搞清楚聽眾是誰：客戶主管不想聽物理機制。

items.def_en: A sentence that moves the audience from one section to the next.
items.example: A clear transition tells the audience which part you are entering.
items.example_zh: 清楚的轉場句能讓聽眾知道你進到哪一段了。

items.def_en: Sounds like um and ah that fill a pause without adding meaning.
items.example: Replace the filler with a short pause; it sounds more confident.
items.example_zh: 把填充詞換成短暫停頓，聽起來更有自信。

items.def_en: How fast you speak, especially through numbers and key points.
items.example: Slow your pace when you read out numbers.
items.example_zh: 唸數字的時候要放慢語速。

items.def_en: An easy working relationship built through small interactions.
items.example: Three minutes of small talk builds enough rapport for a hard discussion.
items.example_zh: 三分鐘的閒聊就足以建立進行硬議題所需的融洽關係。

items.def_en: Light conversation before the real topics begin.
items.example: Weather, travel and time zones are safe small talk topics.
items.example_zh: 天氣、出差、時差是安全的寒暄話題。

items.def_en: An opening remark that makes the first minute easier.
items.example: Asking about their trip is a reliable icebreaker.
items.example_zh: 問對方出差的狀況是很好用的破冰話題。

items.def_en: Moving an issue up to a higher level of management.
items.example: A weekly update is the cheapest way to prevent escalation.
items.example_zh: 每週更新是防止案件升級最便宜的方法。

items.def_en: The rules that decide who approves what.
items.example: Our governance says a stop ship needs director approval.
items.example_zh: 我們的治理機制規定停止出貨需要總監核准。

items.def_en: To help two disagreeing sides reach a workable answer.
items.example: The program manager will mediate between design and process.
items.example_zh: 專案經理會在設計與製程之間居中協調。

items.def_en: A shared understanding of the plan among all parties.
items.example: We need alignment on the release criteria before the gate review.
items.example_zh: 關卡審查前必須先對齊放行標準。

items.def_en: A discussion aimed at reaching terms both sides can accept.
items.example: The negotiation moved once we separated capacity from commercial terms.
items.example_zh: 把產能與商業條件分開談之後，協商才開始有進展。

items.def_en: The position you take in a discussion.
items.example: Our stance is that the parts meet the specification.
items.example_zh: 我們的立場是產品符合規格。

items.def_en: To say that something was caused by a particular factor.
items.example: We cannot attribute the failure to the furnace without a reproduction.
items.example_zh: 沒有重現實驗就不能把失效歸因於爐管。

items.def_en: A small trial run before rolling something out widely.
items.example: We will pilot the new flow on one product family first.
items.example_zh: 我們會先在一個產品家族上試行新流程。

items.def_en: The process of introducing a change across the whole organisation.
items.example: The rollout covers all 14 furnaces from WW35.
items.example_zh: 本次推行自 WW35 起涵蓋全部 14 台爐管。

items.def_en: How fast a team is completing work.
items.example: Our velocity dropped because two engineers moved to the customer case.
items.example_zh: 因為兩位工程師調去處理客訴，我們的推進速度下降。

items.def_en: To split data into meaningful groups before analysing it.
items.example: Segment the returns by date code before you look for a pattern.
items.example_zh: 找規律之前先依生產日期碼把退回品分群。

items.def_en: A value that is close enough for the decision being made.
items.example: This is an approximation; the exact number comes on Friday.
items.example_zh: 這是近似值，確切數字週五會出來。

items.def_en: The most favourable outcome if everything goes right.
items.example: In the best case we release on Friday and ship the same day.
items.example_zh: 最佳情況是週五放行、當天出貨。

items.def_en: Describing the deepest level of a cause rather than a surface effect.
items.example: We separated the root problem from the symptom before proposing a fix.
items.example_zh: 提出對策前，我們先把根本問題與症狀分開。

items.def_en: What the evidence adds up to, stated in one or two sentences.
items.example: State the conclusion first, then support it with the data.
items.example_zh: 先講結論，再用資料支撐它。

items.def_en: How easily a reader understands what you meant.
items.example: Clarity beats completeness in the first page of a report.
items.example_zh: 報告第一頁，清晰比完整更重要。

items.def_en: A step-by-step explanation of a document or process.
items.example: Can you give us a walkthrough of the timeline on slide 2?
items.example_zh: 可以請你逐項導覽第 2 頁的時間軸嗎？

items.def_en: The single point you want remembered if nothing else is.
items.example: The key message is that shipments are protected.
items.example_zh: 核心訊息是：出貨已受到保護。

items.def_en: Extra weight given to one point through wording, tone or layout.
items.example: Put the emphasis on the containment, not on the analysis detail.
items.example_zh: 強調重點要放在圍堵，不是分析細節。

items.def_en: What you conclude the data means, as opposed to the data itself.
items.example: Keep the result and the interpretation in separate sections.
items.example_zh: 把結果與解讀分成兩個段落。

items.def_en: Converting a document from one language into another.
items.example: The Chinese translation of the procedure is the controlled version here.
items.example_zh: 此地的受控版本是該程序的中文翻譯。

items.def_en: The formal approval that lets something proceed.
items.example: We are waiting for the customer sign-off before shipping.
items.example_zh: 我們在等客戶簽核才能出貨。

items.def_en: Going beyond the planned time or budget.
items.example: The overrun is two days, which the buffer absorbs.
items.example_zh: 超時兩天，緩衝時間可以吸收。

items.def_en: The document that states a project's goal, scope and authority.
items.example: The charter says this team owns the process window, not the design.
items.example_zh: 任務書寫明本團隊負責製程窗口，不負責設計。

items.def_en: To release a product to the market or into full production.
items.example: We launch the new node in the first quarter of next year.
items.example_zh: 新製程節點將在明年第一季推出。

items.def_en: A factor that has to be weighed before deciding.
items.example: Tester capacity is the main consideration, not engineering time.
items.example_zh: 主要的考量因素是測試機台產能，不是工程時間。

items.def_en: Careful and thorough checking before committing.
items.example: The auditor expects diligence, which means showing what you checked.
items.example_zh: 稽核員要看到審慎查核，也就是你查了哪些東西。

items.def_en: Politeness, or informing someone as a matter of good practice.
items.example: As a courtesy, we copied the account manager on the reply.
items.example_zh: 基於禮貌，我們把業務窗口加進回信的副本。

items.def_en: How something is expressed, which can change how it is received.
items.example: Change the phrasing from denial to clarification and the tone improves.
items.example_zh: 把說法從否認改成澄清，語氣就好多了。

items.def_en: The feeling a word carries beyond its literal meaning.
items.example: Shortage has a negative connotation; phased delivery does not.
items.example_zh: shortage 帶有負面的言外之意，phased delivery 則沒有。

items.def_en: The opening greeting of a letter or email.
items.example: Match the salutation to how the customer signs their own emails.
items.example_zh: 稱謂要對齊客戶自己署名的方式。

items.def_en: A short item in a list, used instead of a paragraph.
items.example: Keep the summary to three bullet points on the front page.
items.example_zh: 首頁的摘要控制在三個條列重點。

items.def_en: A numbered piece of supporting evidence attached to a document.
items.example: The tool logs are attached as Exhibit 2.
items.example_zh: 機台日誌以佐證附件二的形式附上。

items.def_en: A shortened form of a word or phrase.
items.example: Avoid internal abbreviation in a customer report.
items.example_zh: 客戶報告裡不要用內部縮寫。

items.def_en: A list of terms with their definitions, attached to a document.
items.example: Add a glossary if the report goes to a non-technical reader.
items.example_zh: 若報告要給非技術背景的人看，就加一份詞彙表。

items.def_en: A numbered version of a document after changes.
items.example: That specification is obsolete; please use revision C.
items.example_zh: 該規格已作廢，請改用修訂版 C。

items.def_en: To provide what was promised, on the agreed date.
items.example: We delivered the interim report on the committed date.
items.example_zh: 我們在承諾的日期交付了期中報告。

items.def_en: Spare time in a schedule before a task becomes critical.
items.example: There is no slack left in the schedule after this delay.
items.example_zh: 這次延誤之後，時程已經沒有餘裕。

items.def_en: A detailed split of a total into its parts.
items.example: Please send a breakdown of the fail count by bin.
items.example_zh: 請提供依 bin 分類的失效數細項。

items.def_en: A unit provided for evaluation rather than for production use.
items.example: Samples for your evaluation will be available in WW46.
items.example_zh: 供貴司評估的樣品將於 WW46 提供。

items.def_en: Simplifying a number to fewer digits, which can hide a real difference.
items.example: The gap disappears after rounding, so report one more digit.
items.example_zh: 四捨五入之後差異就不見了，所以要多報一位數。

items.def_en: The formal right to approve or decide something.
items.example: I do not have the authority to approve a shipment under waiver.
items.example_zh: 我沒有核准特採出貨的權限。

items.def_en: The task and authority a team has been formally given.
items.example: Investigating the customer's board is outside our mandate.
items.example_zh: 調查客戶的板子超出我們的職權範圍。

items.def_en: An agreed set of steps that must be followed exactly.
items.example: The escalation protocol says the customer is informed within 48 hours.
items.example_zh: 升級規約規定必須在 48 小時內通知客戶。

items.def_en: The documented way a task must be carried out.
items.example: The quarterly review was added to the standard procedure.
items.example_zh: 季度檢視已寫進標準程序。

items.def_en: Advice on good practice that is not strictly mandatory.
items.example: This is a guideline, not a rule, so use judgement.
items.example_zh: 這是指引不是規定，請自行判斷。

items.def_en: A company-level rule that applies to everyone.
items.example: Company policy requires two approvals for any stop ship.
items.example_zh: 公司政策規定任何停止出貨都需要兩級核准。

items.def_en: An external or industry requirement a product must meet.
items.example: The reliability plan follows the JEDEC standard.
items.example_zh: 可靠度計畫依循 JEDEC 標準規範。

items.def_en: Keeping track of which document version is current and who changed what.
items.example: Poor version control is why two teams used different limits.
items.example_zh: 版本控管不良，正是兩個團隊用到不同界限的原因。

items.def_en: The planned increase in production volume over time.
items.example: The ramp starts in WW44 and reaches full volume in WW52.
items.example_zh: 產能爬坡自 WW44 開始，WW52 達到滿載。

items.def_en: To keep a fact in consideration while deciding.
items.example: Bear in mind that the last data point covers only two lots.
items.example_zh: 請記得最後一個資料點只涵蓋兩個批次。

items.def_en: To include a factor when making a calculation or decision.
items.example: The estimate takes the furnace maintenance into account.
items.example_zh: 這個估算已把爐管保養納入考量。

items.def_en: A formal way to introduce the topic you are answering.
items.example: With regard to your second question, the shipped material is protected.
items.example_zh: 關於您的第二個問題，已出貨的材料是受到保護的。

items.def_en: Signalling that your answer is based on current knowledge and may be incomplete.
items.example: As far as I know no other customer has reported this.
items.example_zh: 就我所知，沒有其他客戶回報過這個問題。

items.term: to the best of my knowledge
items.def_en: A formal hedge used when you cannot guarantee completeness.
items.example: To the best of my knowledge, all affected lots are on hold.
items.example_zh: 據我所知，所有受影響批次都已扣留。

items.term: correct me if I am wrong
items.zh: 如果我理解有誤請指正
items.def_en: A polite way to check your understanding before continuing.
items.example: Correct me if I am wrong, but the line is still running.
items.example_zh: 如果我理解有誤請指正，產線目前仍在運轉，對嗎？

items.def_en: Used before restating a point so there is no misunderstanding.
items.example: Just to be clear, the interim report comes Friday either way.
items.example_zh: 把話講清楚：不論如何，期中報告週五都會出。

items.def_en: Used when you want a statement to be written down officially.
items.example: For the record, the containment was in place before the customer asked.
items.example_zh: 留個紀錄：圍堵措施在客戶提出之前就已就位。

items.def_en: Summarising in the shortest possible form.
items.example: In a nutshell, the alarm limit was wider than the process window.
items.example_zh: 簡而言之，警報界限比製程窗口還寬。

items.def_en: Skipping the detail and going straight to the outcome.
items.example: Long story short, we found the cause and the fix is already running.
items.example_zh: 長話短說：原因找到了，修正措施也已經在跑。

items.term: at the end of the day
items.def_en: Introducing what really matters after all the discussion.
items.example: At the end of the day, the customer needs a date they can rely on.
items.example_zh: 說到底，客戶要的是一個可靠的日期。

items.def_en: Generally true, with minor exceptions.
items.example: By and large the process has been stable since WW35.
items.example_zh: 大致上，製程自 WW35 起就很穩定。

items.def_en: Happening most of the time but not always.
items.example: More often than not, an edge pattern points to the anneal step.
items.example_zh: 多半情況下，邊緣分佈都指向退火製程。

items.def_en: Partly true, used to agree without agreeing fully.
items.example: To some extent both sides are right about the margin.
items.example_zh: 在某種程度上，雙方對餘裕的看法都對。

items.def_en: Agreeing with the idea while leaving the details open.
items.example: In principle we agree, but the quantity has to be confirmed.
items.example_zh: 原則上我們同意，但數量還要確認。

items.def_en: What actually happens, as opposed to what should happen.
items.example: In practice the reminder never reached anyone.
items.example_zh: 實務上那個提醒從來沒送到任何人手上。

items.def_en: According to the documents, which may differ from reality.
items.example: On paper the tool was calibrated; the certificate had expired.
items.example_zh: 紙面上機台是校正過的，但證書已經過期。

items.def_en: The single most important conclusion.
items.example: The bottom line is that we can ship 60 percent of your demand.
items.example_zh: 結論就是：我們能出到您需求的六成。

items.def_en: The overall situation rather than the details.
items.example: Let us step back and look at the big picture before we drill down.
items.example_zh: 在深入細節之前，我們先退一步看全局。

items.def_en: A rough number that is close enough for discussion.
items.example: Can you give me a ballpark figure before the exact count is ready?
items.example_zh: 確切數字出來前，可以先給我一個概略數字嗎？

items.def_en: Approximately, with the stated margin either way.
items.example: It is about forty lots, give or take five.
items.example_zh: 大約四十批，上下五批。

items.def_en: Above the usual value, but not necessarily out of spec.
items.example: The leakage is on the high side but still inside the limit.
items.example_zh: 漏電流偏高，但仍在界限之內。

items.def_en: Below the usual value, but not necessarily a failure.
items.example: Cell current is on the low side for that word line.
items.example_zh: 那條字元線的記憶胞電流偏低。

items.def_en: Outside what this task or meeting is meant to cover.
items.example: That point is out of scope for today, but I will follow up offline.
items.example_zh: 那一點今天不在範圍內，我會後個別追蹤。

items.def_en: Still undecided.
items.example: The sample quantity is still up in the air.
items.example_zh: 樣品數量還沒定案。

items.def_en: Fixed and not open to change.
items.example: The WW40 date is set in stone; everything else can move.
items.example_zh: WW40 這個日期是板上釘釘，其他都可以動。

items.def_en: Paused until a condition is met.
items.example: Twelve wafers are on hold pending the analysis result.
items.example_zh: 十二片晶圓暫停中，等待分析結果。

items.def_en: Still available as an option for discussion.
items.example: A dedicated screening flow is still on the table if volume drops.
items.example_zh: 如果量下來，專屬篩選流程仍在考慮中。

items.def_en: No longer available as an option.
items.example: A full recall is off the table now that the screening is clean.
items.example_zh: 篩選結果乾淨之後，全面召回已不在選項內。

items.def_en: Started but not yet finished.
items.example: Two more cross-sections are in the pipeline for next week.
items.example_zh: 還有兩顆剖面下週進行中。

items.def_en: At some point in the future.
items.example: We can revisit the design change down the road.
items.example_zh: 設計變更可以日後再談。

items.def_en: Finishing earlier than planned.
items.example: The verification finished two days ahead of schedule.
items.example_zh: 驗證比預定進度提早兩天完成。

items.def_en: Later than the planned date.
items.example: We are two weeks behind schedule because of the furnace queue.
items.example_zh: 因為爐管排隊，我們落後進度兩週。

items.def_en: With very little warning time.
items.example: Thank you for joining on short notice.
items.example_zh: 謝謝各位臨時通知還能參加。

items.def_en: Continuously, day and night.
items.example: The lab worked around the clock to finish the cross-section.
items.example_zh: 實驗室全天候趕工才完成剖面分析。

items.def_en: Having to start again from the beginning.
items.example: If the reproduction fails we are back to square one.
items.example_zh: 如果重現失敗，我們就回到原點了。

items.def_en: Something difficult that will take sustained effort.
items.example: Rebuilding credibility after two missed dates is an uphill battle.
items.example_zh: 兩次跳票之後要重建信任是一場硬仗。

items.def_en: The easiest improvements that give quick results.
items.example: Tightening the alarm limit was the low-hanging fruit.
items.example_zh: 收緊警報界限是最容易先做的部分。

items.def_en: A small improvement that can be delivered fast.
items.example: The weekly update is a quick win for customer confidence.
items.example_zh: 每週更新是提升客戶信心的速效做法。

items.def_en: A sign that something is likely to be wrong.
items.example: Seven points in a row above the centre line is a red flag.
items.example_zh: 連續七點落在中心線之上就是警訊。

items.def_en: A problem serious enough to halt everything until it is fixed.
items.example: Failing endurance is a show stopper; we cannot ship at all.
items.example_zh: 耐久度不過就是致命問題，完全不能出貨。

items.def_en: A condition the other side cannot accept under any terms.
items.example: A four percent escape rate is a deal breaker for their automotive line.
items.example_zh: 4% 的漏檢率對他們的車用產線來說是破局條件。

items.def_en: A quick check that a result is not obviously wrong.
items.example: Do a sanity check on the units before you put that number in the report.
items.example_zh: 把數字寫進報告前，先做個單位的合理性檢查。

items.def_en: An estimate based on experience rather than measurement.
items.example: That is an educated guess, and I will label it as one.
items.example_zh: 那是有依據的推測，我會標示清楚。

items.def_en: A rough calculation done quickly to check feasibility.
items.example: A back of the envelope calculation says we need 300 units.
items.example_zh: 粗略估算下來，我們需要 300 顆。

items.def_en: Comparing two things measured under the same conditions.
items.example: That is not apples to apples; the two lots used different recipes.
items.example_zh: 這不是同基準比較，兩個批次用的配方不同。

items.def_en: Placed together so differences are easy to see.
items.example: Put the two wafer maps side by side on one slide.
items.example_zh: 把兩張晶圓分佈圖並列在同一頁。

items.def_en: A private conversation between just two people.
items.example: Let us take the disagreement one on one after the meeting.
items.example_zh: 這個歧見我們會後一對一談。

items.def_en: In person rather than by call or email.
items.example: Difficult topics go better face to face than over email.
items.example_zh: 難談的議題面對面談比用信件好。

items.def_en: One immediately after another with no gap.
items.example: I have back to back meetings until three o'clock.
items.example_zh: 我到三點前的會議都連著排滿。

items.def_en: Physically present rather than remote.
items.example: The auditor wants to see the system in person this afternoon.
items.example_zh: 稽核員想在今天下午親自到場看這套系統。

items.def_en: As a precaution, even if it may not be needed.
items.example: We booked a second furnace slot just in case.
items.example_zh: 我們多訂了一個爐管時段以防萬一。

items.def_en: Only if everything else has failed.
items.example: Scrapping the material is an option only as a last resort.
items.example_zh: 報廢材料只能當作最後手段。

items.def_en: To choose the lower-risk option even if it costs more.
items.example: Let us play it safe and hold the sister lots as well.
items.example_zh: 我們保守處理，把同期批也一起扣住。

items.term: err on the side of caution
items.def_en: To choose the more careful option when the data is unclear.
items.example: With customer material we err on the side of caution.
items.example_zh: 碰到客戶的材料，我們寧可從嚴。

items.def_en: To deal with every possibility so nothing is missed.
items.example: The horizontal check covers all bases across the other tool types.
items.example_zh: 橫向展開把其他機型都涵蓋進去，面面俱到。

items.def_en: To allow space or margin for something that may be needed.
items.example: Leave room for one retest in the schedule.
items.example_zh: 時程上要保留一次重測的空間。

items.def_en: To watch something regularly without acting yet.
items.example: Keep an eye on the spare block usage for the next month.
items.example_zh: 接下來一個月請留意備用區塊的使用量。

items.def_en: To record and follow how something changes.
items.example: Keep track of which sections of the report are still open.
items.example_zh: 持續掌握報告裡還有哪些章節未結。

items.def_en: To stop following something so you no longer know its state.
items.example: We lost track of the second sample batch during the transfer.
items.example_zh: 移轉過程中我們對第二批樣品失去掌握。

items.def_en: To keep fully up to date with something demanding.
items.example: A weekly rhythm helps us stay on top of all open cases.
items.example_zh: 每週的節奏讓我們能掌握住所有未結案件。

items.def_en: To progress more slowly than planned or than others.
items.example: We fell behind because the lab queue doubled in August.
items.example_zh: 八月實驗室排隊時間變成兩倍，我們因此落後。

items.def_en: To be asked something difficult with no time to prepare.
items.example: I was put on the spot for a number I did not have.
items.example_zh: 我當場被逼問一個手邊沒有的數字。

items.def_en: To create delay so you can prepare a proper answer.
items.example: The screening step buys time while the real fix is verified.
items.example_zh: 篩選步驟是在真正的修正驗證期間爭取時間。

items.def_en: To reduce the possibilities to a small number.
items.example: We narrowed it down to two process steps.
items.example_zh: 我們把可能性縮小到只剩兩道製程。

items.def_en: To match or agree with another set of facts.
items.example: The timeline does not line up with the maintenance record.
items.example_zh: 時間軸與保養紀錄對不上。

items.def_en: To include something in a calculation.
items.example: Did you factor in the four hours of extra cycle time?
items.example_zh: 你有把多出來的四小時生產週期算進去嗎？

items.def_en: To finally agree on one option.
items.example: We settled on a phased delivery of eighty units first.
items.example_zh: 我們敲定先交付八十顆的分批方案。

items.def_en: To agree to take on a commitment.
items.example: Be careful what date you sign up for in front of the customer.
items.example_zh: 在客戶面前承諾日期要格外小心。

items.def_en: To retract or soften a statement made earlier.
items.example: We had to walk back the WW36 date after the retest failed.
items.example_zh: 重測失敗後，我們必須收回 WW36 這個日期。

items.def_en: To confirm something in a document rather than verbally.
items.example: Please put the two scenarios in writing before end of day.
items.example_zh: 請在今天下班前把兩個情境白紙黑字寫下來。

items.def_en: To find the real cause of a problem.
items.example: We will get to the bottom of the four unexplained units.
items.example_zh: 那四顆無法解釋的樣品，我們會查個水落石出。

items.def_en: To decide the next step once the current result is known.
items.example: Let us see Thursday's result and take it from there.
items.example_zh: 先看週四的結果，再看下一步怎麼走。

items.def_en: On our side of the process or organisation.
items.example: Everything on our end is ready; we are waiting for your approval.
items.example_zh: 我們這一端都準備好了，只等貴司核准。

items.def_en: To report back so everyone knows the matter is finished.
items.example: I will close the loop with the customer once the report is issued.
items.example_zh: 報告發出後我會跟客戶收尾回報。
